a.notesForNextAgents:
- Everything is in `namespace Trickshot` (the project convention). The eight PURE files must stay free of UnityEngine: they are compiled in a plain .NET console project by the self-test harness (scratchpad/cuptest). Log through `CupLog`, never Debug, in those files.
- Determinism contract: every stream derives from the cup seed with `new SeededRng(seed).Fork(CupSalts.X)`. `Fork(salt)` is a pure function of (constructor Seed, salt): it does NOT advance the parent and the same salt always gives the same stream, so use a distinct `CupSalts` value per purpose (Sim/Coin/Spots/Caller/Dejection per (stage,index); Order per stage; Draw/Podium/Confetti). Never use System.Random or UnityEngine.Random for anything peers must agree on. `Next01()` is integer-derived; float `Range` is plain float math.
- `CupBracket.Build(seed, format, humans, aiPool)`: humans as `(nationIndex, humanSlot, humanName)` tuples (a `List<(int,int,string)>` converts fine), max 16, distinct slots and nations; humans are sorted by slot internally so caller order does not matter. Co-op passes ONE entry (the Captain's slot + `CupText.YourTeam` or similar). At runtime pass `CupNations.ResolvedPool()` as `aiPool` so a drifted table row is skipped; every peer must pass the same pool. Entrant index == Round of 32 slot (round i = entrants 2i, 2i+1).
- Round results: build a `RoundLine(firstKicker)` per round, feed `CupRoundRules.Record/RecordKick`, poll `IsDecided`, then `bracket.SetResult(round, line, simulated:false)`. `CupRound.ToLine()` reconstructs a RoundLine (needs FirstKicker). `KickRecord`/`RoundLine` are classes, not structs. Free-kick spot index for the next kick = `CupRoundRules.PairIndex(line)`.
- The host validates a client-reported result with `CupRoundRules.Validate(kicks, firstKicker, 5, requireDecided:true, out line, out err)` and uses `line.GoalsA/GoalsB` as the authoritative scores.
- Wire: `CupBracket.ToBytes()` (version byte 1 first) is ~460 B fresh / ~650 B finished, worst case ~1.1 KB — for CupState prefer shipping per-round results with `CupRound.WriteTo/ReadFrom` (stage+index+entrants+scores+flags+winner+packed kicks) and rebuilding the tree from the seed; or send the whole bracket on ReliableBulk. `CupByteWriter/Reader` are the pure serialisers (little-endian; `Slot` writes -1 as 255).
- `CupNationTable` order = `JerseyDesigns.InTab(DesignTab.Nations)` order (ordinal, case-insensitive: "Uruguay" < "USA"), so table index == tab index today; lookups are by name anyway (`CupNations.Design(i)` caches). Indices ride the wire: if the jersey library gains a nation, APPEND a row, do not re-sort (Validate will warn about drift either way). `CupNations.Validate()` runs lazily on the first `Design()` call and also from the editor menu.
- `CupNations.PrimaryColor/SecondaryColor` sample the 48x48 thumb (3-bit-per-channel bins, runner-up must differ by >=0.35 RGB distance); fall back to white/black. Painting the full kit atlas on a torso is NOT here: use `CupNations.Design(i).Apply(Color32[])` on a JerseyDesigns atlas buffer (AtlasW x AtlasH) as CustomizeUI does, then `Make.MatTex`/`SetTorsoMaterial`.
- `CupSim`: `Simulate(round, bracket, rng)` uses the rng as given (caller forks; `CupSim.StreamFor(bracket, round)` gives the canonical one); `SimulateStage(..., aiOnly:true)` is the between-stages "simulating the rest of the stage", `SimulateNextStage` is one "Simulate the rest" press, `SimulateRemaining` finishes the cup. Simulated sudden death is capped at 10 pairs (30 kicks) with a statistically exact decisive last pair; played rounds have no cap. Non-goals split SAVED/MISS by `SimSaveShare` (flavour only).
- `KickOutcome` is packed into 2 bits on the wire (max four values). `CupSide?` FirstKicker rides in the round's flag byte.
- `CupText` holds every exact user-facing string plus builders; `Hud.KindOf` will need "KNOCKED OUT" (failure tier), "HEADS"/"TAILS" (informational) and " WIN" (good) per the design — that edit is in Hud.cs, outside my ownership.
- Unity was not opened: no .meta files exist yet for Assets/Scripts/Cup/ (the editor generates them on refresh). The compile script defines UNITY_EDITOR and references UnityEditor.dll, so CupSelfTestMenu.cs is compile-checked too.
- Re-run the self-test any time with `cd <scratchpad>/cuptest && dotnet run -c Release` (the csproj includes the pure files by absolute path) or in the editor via Trickshot > Cup > Run self-test.

b2.notesForNextAgents:
NAMING: the round driver is `CupRoundDriver` in CupRoundDriver.cs, NOT `CupRound` - the foundations already define `sealed class CupRound` (the pure round record) in CupBracket.cs, and `CupRoundDriver.Data` is of that type. Unity needs a MonoBehaviour's file name to equal its class name, so the file could not be CupRound.cs either.

WIRING (GameBootstrap agent): (1) In BuildMode, ABOVE Arena.Build, call `CupDirector.ApplyCupStatics(format, CupStage.RoundOf32)` (idempotent, snapshots once) exactly like the Accuracy challenge does, so the goal frame is built at regulation; Launch calls it again and only rebuilds if something differs. (2) After the ball + GameCamera exist: `CupDirector.Launch(root, style, format, seed, GetInput(), cam, gameCam, ball, arena.goalCenter, torso, limb, glove, ReturnToMainMenu)`; for an MP client also set `director.OnLeave = LeaveNetworkedMatch`. Solo seed: `CupDirector.RollSeed()` at the fork screen; MP: MatchConfig.fkSeed. (3) Restore of every borrowed static happens in the director's OnDestroy (match teardown) - no rebuild of the goal there. (4) The director starts in CupPhase.NationPick; screens are separate components that `director.AddGuiHook(Draw)` and call the intents. Pause: PauseMatchSetup.RowsFor(TrickshotCup) should be 0; onRestart/onFullSetup null.

AUTHORITY MODEL: `IsAuthority` = Solo, no session, or the host. Intents apply locally when authoritative, else fire `RequestRaised(kind, arg, payload)` - the net agent subscribes to that (client->host CupRequest) and to `StateChanged` (host broadcasts CupState). The host's request handler calls the public Apply* methods for the remote slot (ApplyPick/ApplyReady/ApplySpectate/ApplyLoaded/ApplyCoinCall/ApplyRoundResult(CupRound.ReadFrom(payload))); a client applies CupState with SetPhase(phase, hostTimer), SetBracket / RecordResult, SetCaptainSlot, DecideTeamNation, ApplyOrder, and CupRoundState with Driver.ApplyState. Round authority is separate: `AuthorityFor(round)` returns Local for Solo and for Head to Head human-vs-AI rounds (played on the owner's machine), Host/Client for Co-op and human-vs-human rounds. Co-op Captain == host, so CaptainDecides/SetOrder/PullLever are host-local (they ride CupState, never a request). On a client `CaptainSlot` defaults to HostSlotDefault (1) until SetCaptainSlot arrives.

FLOW AGENTS: the three partials hold the per-phase switch with TODO(Solo|HeadToHead|Coop) and a roadmap in each file header. The typical round sequence is: SetPhase(Loading) -> StartRound(LocalRoundThisStage) (driver Configures = C1 builds the scene under RoundRoot) -> NotifyLoaded/AllLoaded -> SetPhase(CoinToss) -> calls via ApplyCoinCall, result from `Driver.Setup.Stream(CupSalts.Coin(stage, index)).Coin()`, ResolveCoinCalls(result), `Driver.SetFirstKicker(CupRoundRules.FirstKickerFromCall(Driver.Setup.CoinCaller, call, result))` -> `Driver.Begin()`; SetPhase(Round) -> when `Driver.Phase == RoundPhase.Over`: `RecordResult(CurrentRound, Driver.Line)`, `EndRound()`, `SimulateAiRounds(Stage)`, later `AdvanceStage()`. `UpdateLiveRow()` keeps the lobby row live. `SimulateRest()` = one KNOCKED OUT press. PhaseTime uses Time.deltaTime (Solo pause freezes it at timeScale 0; MP keeps running).

C1 (round driver): implement the `partial void On*` hooks in new partial files (e.g. CupRoundDriver.Scene.cs, .Choreo.cs); write the read model through the protected setters or the private-set properties (same class); call `ResolveKick(outcome, scorerSlot)` for every verdict (it records under the rules, mirrors Data, fires KickResolved/RoundDecided, returns the winner or null) and `SetPhase(...)` for choreography; the kick clock counts down automatically while Armed on Local/Host authority (SetKickClock to override). `Setup.Rng` is the cup root - fork with CupSalts.Coin/Spots/Dejection(Stage, Data.Index). Fill CaptureState extras in OnStateCaptured (body ids, WindowRemaining, SkipVotes, CoinCall/Result). `SkipCelebration()` on Client authority deliberately does nothing (the director raised the request).

IMGUI: OnGuiHook is drawn in list order (last = on top); Add/Remove during a GUI pass are deferred to the next Update so control ids never shift between Layout and Repaint. CupSetupUI's Card() is a private copy of AccuracyModeUI.Card (that one is private) - reuse the pattern, not the method.

TESTING: scratchpad/cupstatetest (sibling of cuptest) round-trips CupRoundState; run with `dotnet run -c Release` there. CupRoundState.cs is pure and may be added to cuptest's csproj.
openIssues: File/class name deviates from the task text: the driver is CupRoundDriver (CupRoundDriver.cs), because `CupRound` is already the foundations' pure round record and Unity's MonoBehaviour file-name rule forbids reusing the file name; agents should code against `CupRoundDriver` / `CupRoundDriver.Data` (a `CupRound`).

On an MP client, `CaptainSlot` is assumed to be slot 1 (HostSlotDefault) until the host's CupState calls `SetCaptainSlot` - NetSession.SlotOf(peer) is private, so a client cannot resolve the host's seat itself.

`CoinCallerFor` / `MakeRoundSetup` derive the Co-op team side from `LocalEntrant`; a peer whose bracket has not been installed yet (LocalEntrant -1) falls back to side A - always SetBracket/BuildBracket before StartRound.
The style partials contain no transitions at all (only TODO(<style>) roadmaps): a launched director sits in NationPick until the flow agents fill SoloTick/HeadToHeadTick/CoopTick.
`RestoreCupStatics` deliberately does not rebuild the goal (it runs during match teardown); the next mode's setup writes the goal size before its arena is built, as today.

b1.publicApi:
ALL in `namespace Trickshot` unless noted (Net types in `Trickshot.Net`).

=== GameMode (MenuUI.cs) ===
`public enum GameMode { Striker, Goalkeeper, Accuracy, FreeKick, Match, SetPieces, TrickshotCup }` (TrickshotCup = 6, appended). `MenuUI.SoloModes` and `MultiplayerHubUI.NetModes` both end with `GameMode.TrickshotCup`. `PauseMenu.ModeName(GameMode.TrickshotCup)` == CupText.TitleMixed ("Trickshot Cup"). `MenuSceneStage.Create(TrickshotCup)` -> `new FreeKickScene()` (placeholder until a CupScene exists). `PauseMatchSetup.RowsFor(TrickshotCup)` = 0 -> `HasLiveSettings(TrickshotCup)` false.

=== Wire (Trickshot.Net, NetMessages.cs) ===
`struct MatchConfig { ...; public float goalScaleH; public byte cupStyle; public byte cupFormat; }` - cupStyle = (byte)CupStyle (1 HeadToHead, 2 Coop; 0 never hosted), cupFormat = (byte)CupFormat; written by NetCodec.Roster right after goalScaleH, read UNCONDITIONALLY by ReadRoster. `NetCodec.ProtocolVersion = 8` (history comment extended). `public enum NetRole : byte { Shooter=0, Keeper=1, Spectator=2, Crosser=3, Entrant=4 }`.

=== NetSession (Trickshot.Net) ===
`public static NetRole RoleForSlot(int slot, GameMode mode)` - Entrant for TrickshotCup, Match shirt logic, else RoleOfSlot; the private `RoleForSlot(int)` delegates with Config.mode (used by GrantSlot / ApplySlotRequest / RebuildRoster, so roster rows and AssignSlot carry Entrant in the cup).
`public static string ModeWord(GameMode mode)` -> "Trickshot Cup" for the cup ("Set Pieces", else mode.ToString()).
`public string ModeLabel()` -> for the cup `CupLabel(CupStyleOf(Config), (CupFormat)Config.cupFormat)`.
`public static CupStyle CupStyleOf(in MatchConfig cfg)` (Coop iff cupStyle==2, else HeadToHead).
`public static string CupLabel(CupStyle style, CupFormat format)` -> "Trickshot Cup - Head to Head - Penalties" (== CupText.Label; LabelIsMode(label, TrickshotCup) matches it).
`public static bool ParseCupLabel(string label, out CupStyle style, out CupFormat format)` - false for non-cup / older / truncated labels (outs default HeadToHead/Penalties).
Seating: `SlotAllowed(slot)` true for all 8 slots in the cup; `GrantSlot` seats a cup joiner in the lowest free slot 0..7 (host stays at slot 1 from Host()); `HasFreeSlot` follows; `SetConfig(cfg)` clears every `_slotAi` when cfg.mode is the cup (unfilled seats publish as "Open", never "Clanker").
`LobbyUI.RoleName` (private) returns CupText.EntrantRole ("Entrant") for NetRole.Entrant.

=== PauseMenu ===
`public static bool Paused { get; private set; }` (unchanged meaning: the menu is up; INPUT gates keep reading it).
`public static bool Overlay { get; set; }` - set true by GameBootstrap.BuildMode for a NETWORKED cup, cleared in TearDownMatch. With Overlay, Pause() never touches Time.timeScale.
`public static bool Frozen => Paused && !Overlay;` - the reader for everything that stops time/sim. Switched to Frozen: GameCamera.LateUpdate, AudioManager.Update crowd bed, NetMatch/NetSetPieceMatch/NetStrikerMatch/GameManager/KeeperGame/FreeKickGame/MatchGame/AccuracyGame Update gates. Still `Paused`: the wheel/map/end-card OnGUI guards (they hide UI under the menu).
`public void SetCupLabels(string quitLabel, string confirmTitle, string confirmBody)` - collapses Leave Match + Main Menu/End Match into ONE entry: label as given, Act = onLeave when a client (onLeave != null) else onMainMenu; confirm title upper-cased. null label = stock entries.

=== GoalEditor ===
`public enum KeeperRow { Ladder, YesNo, None }` - None draws no keeper label/buttons (nothing allocated), keeperLevel untouched; the figure still stands beside the post when keeperLevel > 0.

b1.notesForNextAgents:
1) PAUSE CONTRACT for the cup driver/choreography: gate the LOCAL player's input on `PauseMenu.Paused` (cursor is freed by the menu), gate anything that advances the sim/clock/camera on `PauseMenu.Frozen`. In Head to Head / Co-op `PauseMenu.Overlay` is true (set in GameBootstrap.BuildMode), so Frozen is never true there; in Solo it freezes as before. Do not write Time.timeScale yourself while the overlay is up.
2) QUIT ROUTING: the pause menu's single quit entry calls `CupDirector.Instance.QuitToMenu()` (host -> EndMatch -> OnMainMenu; client -> OnLeave; Solo -> OnMainMenu). The director's OnMainMenu/OnLeave are the RAW GameBootstrap ReturnToMainMenu / LeaveNetworkedMatch - never call the pause closures from inside the director or it loops. TearDownMatch destroys _matchRoot at end of frame (director OnDestroy -> RestoreCupStatics) and clears PauseMenu.Overlay + CupLaunch.
3) CURSOR: BuildCup leaves the cursor FREE (the cup opens on CHOOSE YOUR NATION). Each round must CaptureCursor(true) itself; `PauseMenu.Resume()` re-captures unconditionally (same contract as the accuracy end card - re-assert CaptureCursor(false) on menu screens after an unpause).
4) MP LOBBY: every seat is NetRole.Entrant; `NetSession.SetConfig` clears all AI seats for the cup so unfilled rows read "Open" (the host can still toggle AI on a row - the director already skips non-human roster rows). Joiners seat 0..7 lowest-free; the host sits at slot 1. The advert label is `NetSession.CupLabel(style, format)`; `ParseCupLabel` reads it back; NEVER change CupText.StyleName/FormatName spellings without keeping the parse symmetric.
5) STATICS: BuildMode calls `CupDirector.ApplyCupStatics(CupLaunch.Format, RoundOf32)` above Arena.Build - the director's Launch calls it again (idempotent). The launch values come ONLY from CupLaunch (Solo: `CupLaunch.Solo(format)` from the fork; MP: `CupLaunch.FromConfig(cfg)` in StartNetworkedMatch on every peer). A session-less launch is forced to Solo; a session with cupStyle 0 is forced to HeadToHead.
6) REFEREE: `JerseyDesigns.Find(JerseyDesigns.RefereeName)` -> paint with Make.MatTex on the torso; give him black limb + shorts materials yourself (cuffs cannot be drawn on the torso atlas).
7) EMOTES: wire ids TrophyLift=33, DejectKnees=34, DejectHips=35, DejectFall=36, WhistleRaise=37; none on the wheel Pages (curate the podium page yourself). DejectFall only poses the arms - free the body (balance off, upright off, nudge back) at ~0.8 s in the choreography. WhistleRaise reaches the mouth at p=0.45 (0.4 s of 0.9 s) - fire PlayWhistle there. DejectKnees uses RootLift -0.45 (the pelvis sinks; live body via EmoteHeightOffset, puppet via DisplayEmote).
8) STATS: call CupCareer.* from the director (pass the cup's Style, never Multiplayer.IsActive): Entered after the draw; StageReached as each stage opens; KickTaken/KickKept per verdict for the LOCAL player's own kicks; CoinCalled after the flip for every local call; RoundDecided(round, ownSide, Bracket, Style) when a round closes; Won(nation, Style) on the Final. BestStageLabel/BeatsBest feed the KNOCKED OUT card's career-best line.
9) Hud.Flash words: "GOAL"/"SAVED" green, "MISS" red, "HEADS"/"TAILS" grey, "<NATION> WIN a-b" green, "KNOCKED OUT a-b" red - already classified; do not prefix "KNOCKED OUT" lines with another good word.
10) Shared-file edits outside my list, minimal: LobbyUI.RoleName (+1 case), GoalEditor (+KeeperRow.None, no keeper-row draw), AudioManager.BeginMatch swell set (+TrickshotCup). GameBootstrap.DestroyNetworkedUI does not list CupSetupUI (SP-only, never up during a session).
